#flags: Descriptions for HDLForge native command options.

flags.#--auto_impl: After synthesis succeeds run this implementation pinned to its stable run ID; repeatable, deduplicated
flags.#--build_status: Probe the output-root launch registry and report non-dead registered processes
flags.#--build_status_all: Show all registered builds, including completed, failed, stopped, and dead runs
flags.#--clean_ignore_artifacts: Delete a run only when every descendant is untracked and ignored and no run lock is held; --dry-run previews candidates and skip reasons
flags.#--init_build_example: Alias for creating all three build examples and their Tcl folders
flags.#--build_lint: Check build configuration and input paths without starting Vivado
flags.#--build: Run a JSON synth, synth.impl, IP, or SYNTH.latest.IMPL.bitstream.ID selector; use --help for portable run.json and artifact layout
flags.#--synth_timestamp: Select a synthesis by stable run ID or folder label; default uses newest JSON creation time and requires completion
flags.#--jobs: Maximum parallel jobs passed to Vivado (default 1).
flags.#--follow: Refresh process identity and log status every two seconds.
flags.#--run: Run name passed directly to Vivado; Vivado handles dependencies and rejection.
flags.#--property: Select one property of the specified saved run.
flags.#--summary: Show saved run status grouped by synthesis parent without contacting Vivado.
flags.#--json: Print machine-readable run inventory or saved values.
flags.#--flags: Additional Verilator flags; may be repeated
flags.#--file: Project-relative Verilator source file(s) for dependency-aware lint
flags.#--lint-file: Project-relative Verilator source file(s) for raw selected-file lint
flags.#-f: Skip confirmation prompts for the selected operation.
flags.#--force: Skip confirmation prompts for the selected operation.
flags.#--cmd: Execute a shell command, or select the chosen native tool's command.
flags.#--eth_dst_mac: Ethernet destination MAC address (default: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF for requests)
flags.#--get_modules_list: List all modules in the design
flags.#--get_values_pins: Module path to list value changes for pins only (excludes sub-modules)
flags.#--get_values_all: Module path to list value changes for all signals (excludes sub-modules)
flags.#--human: Human-readable output format with padding (for --get_values_pins or --get_values_all)
flags.#--frame_list: Comma-separated list of frame numbers to display
flags.#--count: Number of packets to display (use with --skip for pagination)
flags.#--skip: Skip this many packets before displaying
flags.#--tsharkArgsAppend: Additional raw tshark arguments to append
flags.#--disable_protocols: Comma-separated list of protocols to disable (e.g., mndp,ssdp)
flags.#-c: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#--hw-config: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#--config-file: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#-i: Interactive mode for hw_server (keep console open)
flags.#--interactive: Interactive mode for hw_server (keep console open)
flags.#-ic: Run commands then exit for hw_server (e.g., -ic 2 i1)
flags.#--interactive-chain: Run commands then exit for hw_server (e.g., -ic 2 i1)
flags.#-d: Enable debug output showing TCL commands and inputs
flags.#--debug: Enable debug output showing TCL commands and inputs
flags.#--list: List all available projects recursively from current directory
flags.#--raw: Print Tcl output without table formatting
flags.#--output: Override the write_tcl destination; default is the project's configured Tcl
flags.#--timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for the console or command lock (default: 180)
flags.#--json-file: Existing JSON file for install-json; update-json detects its own selected file
flags.#--key: Dotted parent key for installation, e.g. LLM_orch.vivado; replace its project_console group entirely
flags.#--project-json: HDLForge project selected by the native --project option
flags.#--overwrite: Allow install-json to replace an existing project_console group; update-json always replaces it
flags.#--get_xpr_path: Print the absolute configured XPR path without starting Vivado; works before project creation.
flags.#--project_console: Persistent Vivado Tcl console, interactive commands and inspection
flags.#--eval_json: Execute a command from the selected project's JSON key.
flags.#--append: Append arguments to the selected project shortcut or shell command.
flags.#--dry-run: Preview artifact cleanup candidates and skip reasons without deleting; for other commands, resolve without executing.
flags.#--env-python: Add Python paths from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--env-path: Add executable search paths from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--env-var: Set environment variables for the launched command from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--group: Synthesis group from get_groups; process synthesis and enabled implementations.
flags.#--lines: Number of trailing log lines to display (default 8).
flags.#--monitor: Monitor runs: status, timing-graph, tail, collection, and management. Use help for all actions.
flags.#--refresh_impl_inputs: New implementation: snapshot current XDC/Tcl/supporting files while retaining synthesis DCP and frozen IPs
flags.#--build_stop_all: Stop registered launches and cancel pending implementations; report unregistered Vivado processes
flags.#--build_find_all_user_runs: Discover all visible current-user Vivado processes, including unregistered launches
flags.#--build_create: Create synthesis, nested implementation, and IP regeneration JSON examples and run.tcl folders; no builds or overwrites
flags.#--build_clean_ignore_artifacts: Delete ignored timestamp artifacts across all runs; --dry-run lists candidates and skip reasons without deleting; no PID/status checks

#values: Descriptions for native tool and command choices.

values.#vivado: Create, inspect, and build Vivado projects; manage consoles and run databases.
values.#Verilator: Build, run, or lint HDL simulations using Verilator.
values.#network: Send raw Ethernet, ARP, ICMP, or UDP packets.
values.#vcd_analyzer: Inspect modules and signal transitions in VCD waveform files.
values.#tsharkWrapper: Decode and filter packets from capture files with tshark.
values.#hw_server: Program and inspect FPGA hardware through Vivado hardware server.
values.#lint: Lint the selected HDL sources or simulation target.
values.#send_arp: Send an ARP request or response.
values.#program: Program the selected FPGA bitstream and probes.
values.#scan_jtag: Scan devices on the JTAG chain.
values.#read_dna: Read the FPGA device DNA identifier.
values.#to_plain_text: Render decoded packets as plain text.

#project_console: Reusable native Vivado project management actions and their shortcut names.

project_console.#follow: Select active runs once from the console, then follow only their logs and logged PIDs. Optional --group SYNTH --interval 5 --once. Ctrl-C stops only the display.
project_console.#set_run_property: Edit a run with --run NAME --property PROPERTY --value VALUE and read it back. Without --property, list its properties.
project_console.#close_project: Close an explicitly opened project and keep the console alive; active runs are protected.
project_console.#status: Show console liveness and the currently open design or project.
project_console.#start: Start or reuse the persistent Tcl console without creating or opening a project.
project_console.#restart: Terminate and restart this managed Tcl console without opening a project.
project_console.#stop: Kill the console targeted by this HDLForge JSON immediately. No close_project command or export prompt.
project_console.#get_runs: List live runs grouped by synthesis and implementation children.
project_console.#get_groups: List synthesis groups and their implementation children.
project_console.#run_info: Show run configuration and stage settings for --run NAME; --verbose adds all other properties.
project_console.#run_status: Show Vivado status, progress, elapsed time and timing for --run NAME.
project_console.#group_info: Show configuration and stage settings for each run in --group SYNTH; --verbose adds all other properties.
project_console.#group_status: Show live status and timing for --group SYNTH.
project_console.#reuse_status: Show --run NAME refresh requirement and incremental checkpoint settings.
project_console.#interactive: Attach to the persistent Tcl terminal; detach with Ctrl-b d.
project_console.#send: Execute --cmd TCL in the console without opening or changing its project.
project_console.#source: Source --file PATH in the console without changing its project.
project_console.#install-json: Install project_console shortcuts with --json-file FILE --key PARENT; optional --overwrite.
project_console.#update-json: Update this project console shortcut group, retaining unrelated settings.

monitor.#tail: Follow one runme.log by run name. Append --run NAME; optional --lines 50 or --no-follow for a snapshot. Ctrl-C stops only the log view.
monitor.#timing-graph: List available runs, saved status, sample counts, logs, and graph commands when called without arguments. Append --run NAME or --file timing_progress.json to plot timing; optional --metric wns and --kind completed.
monitor.#clear: Clear saved monitor records for all runs, or append a run name. Build files are kept; runs are rediscovered on the next scan.
monitor.#collect: Analyze and accumulate artifacts for one confirmed closed run. Append --run NAME; preserves earlier evidence.
monitor.#help: Show monitor commands and their arguments.
monitor.#help-slack: Show Slack token setup and interactive status-menu instructions.
monitor.#help-verbose: Show the full monitor guide: discovery, PID checks, stale status, remote execution, and collection.
monitor.#restart: Terminate and restart this managed Tcl console without opening a project.
monitor.#scan: Discover all runs from the targeted HDLForge JSON, check logs/PIDs, update status, and dispatch lifecycle tasks.
monitor.#start: Start or reuse the persistent Tcl console without creating or opening a project.
monitor.#stop: Stop only the monitor daemon. Does not stop Vivado builds or collection workers already launched.
monitor.#print-hdlforge-json-commands: Print the reusable monitor shortcut JSON with descriptions; does not modify files.
monitor.#install-json: Install monitor shortcuts into an existing JSON file. Append --json-file FILE --key PARENT; --overwrite replaces an existing monitor group.
monitor.#update-json: Refresh this monitor shortcut group and its descriptions in the targeted HDLForge JSON, preserving existing vivado.monitor settings and sibling configuration.
monitor.#performance: List collected stage performance files and arguments. Append --files FILE [FILE ...] to compare; --metric elapsed_seconds|cpu_seconds|peak_memory_mb|wns_ns|tns_ns|whs_ns|ths_ns, --stage TEXT, --graph.
